subject.title: fix(mcp): stop ignored disabled servers from starting

question: Should legacy MCP `disabled` values in include layouts that cannot be rewritten safely fail validation and require direct operator repair?
rationale: The narrow automatic migration is technically sound, but the remaining behavior is an observable upgrade contract that trades silent unwanted process startup for an explicit validation stop and operator action.

options.title: Accept guarded fail-closed migration
options.body: Automatically repair only unambiguous ownership cases and require direct edits for complex include layouts.

options.title: Expand include repair first
options.body: Delay the validation change until additional include ownership patterns can be migrated without flattening or overwriting authored configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Automatically repair only unambiguous ownership cases and require direct edits for complex include layouts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history on the affected config, doctor, MCP, and include-write contracts.
